turei-zahav/2:_.en: As the fifth son as the sixth son. P. All sharp to Pom Horfia and P. How does Ar Asi, a small son of 6, go out with his mother's marriage, F. If he married himself and did not give him a marriage certificate for his marriage with her, the blood of Damasma, her opinion was about the little one, why don't you follow her, his mother, a good boy who should go to his mother, he goes out with his mother's marriage, and that his mother does not go out with his mother's marriage, and Nami Gabi is a sukkah, as a small child, that his mother owes him a sukkah And I said, Rabbi Yanai and RL, and some about the 4th year, the 5th year, and the 16th year, according to Rabbi Yehoshua, and he stayed in Tiovath, and after that, it was crisp on Rabbi Assi, what is a small datanya that his mother needs to go out in Irov, his mother until the age of six, and secondly, according to Rabbi Assi, until the age of 10 years. 4 And above and Barita in Daliti' to Abu' in Mata Hoi Shifra until Ben 6 and Rif and Rambam did not write anything but the words of Rabbi Asi separately because I do not trust him' Ahai Shinu'a Daiti' to Abu Daha not from the second most to Rabbi Asi but from second to all and Rabbi Yanai and RL is Demshani the most because it is not Sal to all and Rabbi Asi Nakti' from my image in Gm' Sep A.P. And so the Torah and the Rash and the Tor ruled in the Irovin above C. 14 Kvaya chaluka dish to the father in Mata or not and here they did not mention this division but the Tor ruling as ben 6 as ben 7 and we were like Rabbi Asi Darb Asi Nekt ben 6 we were (ben 6) [7] Shallim and the Tor Dankt ben 7 [we were ben Tachalat 7 and of course it is difficult why he did not rule here also as a masha in the the Omnipresent Irovin Sepid And K. B. To interpret the words of our Rabbi, the tor here is connected as ben 6, as ben 7. Pi, if itai' to Abova in the room, his lesson is as ben 5, and if Lithia is in the room, his lesson is as ben 7, and this way is far from the Rabbi of the Tor to write through such an allusion, but to the model of the Rash and the tor, Sal. And there is no division in Aith whether or not Rabbi Yanai and Rabbi Sal have a division. And it seems to the Rash and the Tor to rule as Rabbi Assi in Irov, that is, to make it stricter that his mother does not make a prohibition to bring her son with her when he has a father in the city of Daha. Rabbi Yanai and RL have a prohibition on this, but here in the Sukkah the obligation of education is to encourage them and sit and do not do something like this. And to educate him is the sixth son, until he is the seventh son, and this is what our rabbi meant in the Tur — source. here, who wrote that Darbanan is obliged to educate him, because of some necessity he remembered that the obligation is from Darbanan, but for the qualification we mentioned, there is nothing in this but from Darbanan. The above is true and clear in the words of the Tur — source. and the MS here in the Sha'a as the 5th son as the 6th son means completeness per the opinion of the Tur — source. we mentioned.
